text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This original research paper explicitly focuses on spatiotemporal modeling and prediction of land use change (LUC) in Brazil at the national scale, disaggregated into six macro-regions. It uses a spatially explicit land use allocation model (PLUC) combined with a global CGE model (MAGNET) and a GIS-based carbon module to simulate future LUC dynamics resulting from increased bioethanol demand towards 2030. The study implements multiple future scenarios including a reference and three mitigation scenarios, quantitatively comparing their effects on LUC and related GHG emissions. The output includes mapped LUC projections with quantitative metrics such as emissions per MJ bioethanol and percentage reductions due to mitigation. The scale is national (Brazil), with spatially explicit modeling and scenario analysis, meeting all core inclusion criteria and none of the exclusion criteria.)
